evidence_items.explanation: Winoground requires matching two images to captions containing the same words in different orders. Its poor group scores across contemporary vision-language models support substantial difficulty preserving the changed relationships.

This later analysis finds that visual discrimination and combining visual with linguistic information also affect performance. It limits any inference that word-order processing alone caused the observed failures.

unresolved_gaps: The evaluation does not establish the failure rate for the exact cat-and-mat sentence or every contemporary language model.
